name: Scheduliyo – Appointment Booking Calendar & Scheduling
author: scheduliyo

sections.description:
Scheduliyo is a free appointment booking plugin for WordPress that turns your website into a 24/7 online booking system. Customers choose a service, pick a staff member, select a date and time slot, and confirm – in a few clicks, without leaving your site. You manage every appointment, service, staff schedule and customer record from your WordPress dashboard.

The free version has no limits on services, staff, locations, customers or bookings. It never asks for a license key or an external account, and your booking data stays on your own server.

Why choose Scheduliyo for appointment scheduling?

  • Unlimited free version – unlimited services, staff members, locations, customers and appointments. No caps and no trial period.
  • No sign-up, no license key – install it, run the setup wizard and start accepting bookings.
  • Self-hosted and private – appointments and customer details live in your own WordPress database, not on a third-party platform.
  • Fewer no-shows – automatic email reminders, plus manual reminders when you need them.
  • Less admin back-and-forth – customers reschedule or cancel on their own through a secure link in their confirmation email.
  • Works with your theme – add the booking form to any page or post with a shortcode or a block.

How it works

  1. Install and activate Scheduliyo from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Run the setup wizard – pick your industry and it fills in your services, prices and working hours.
  3. Add the booking form to a page with the [scheduliyo_booking] shortcode or the Scheduliyo Booking block.
  4. Customers book online – they see live availability, confirm, and get a confirmation email with their own manage-booking link.
  5. Manage everything from the booking calendar and dashboard in WordPress.

Online booking form (shortcode & block)

  • Step-by-step booking – customers pick a service → staff member → date → available time slot, then confirm.
  • Live availability – open time slots come from each staff member’s working hours, breaks and approved time off.
  • Mobile-friendly – the booking flow fits any phone, tablet or desktop screen.
  • Instant confirmation – with a booking reference, a check-in QR code and Add to Calendar links for Google Calendar and Outlook.com.
  • Easy to place – the [scheduliyo_booking] shortcode or the Scheduliyo Booking block.

Customer self-service: cancel & reschedule

  • Secure manage-booking link – every confirmation email includes one.
  • No login needed – customers reschedule or cancel an appointment themselves, so you get fewer phone calls and your schedule stays current.
  • One shortcode – add the page with [scheduliyo_manage_booking].

Booking calendar & admin dashboard

  • Booking calendar – month, week, day and agenda views, colour-coded by staff member.
  • Dashboard – bookings, revenue, customers and completion rate for the period you choose.
  • Booking management – create, edit, reschedule and cancel appointments from the WordPress admin, handy for phone and walk-in bookings.
  • Quick search – find any booking by name, phone, email or booking ID, and filter by staff, service, status and payment.

Services management

  • Each service on its own terms – name, duration, price, category, photo and description.
  • Any time-based service – haircuts, consultations, therapy sessions, lessons, inspections and more.
  • Choose who delivers it – link each service to the staff members who provide it.

Staff scheduling

  • Working hours and breaks for each staff member.
  • Approved time off – leave days are blocked in the booking calendar automatically.
  • No WordPress logins needed – staff are managed as booking records. To let a WordPress user into the admin area, give them one of Scheduliyo’s built-in roles (Users → Edit).

Locations & customer database

  • Business location with map – store your business address and place it on an interactive map.
  • Customer database – keep a record of every customer and their booking history, with no limit on the number of customers.

Email notifications & appointment reminders

  • Every booking email – confirmations, reminders, reschedules and cancellations.
  • Automatic reminders – sent a chosen number of hours before each confirmed appointment, with a ready-made reminder email created in one click (Settings → Booking → Booking Reminders).
  • Manual reminders – send one by hand from any booking.
  • Reliable delivery – through standard WordPress mail or your own SMTP server.
  • Delivery log – see what was sent for every email.

Offline payments & invoices

  • Offline payments – record in-person payments, such as cash at the counter, including deposits and part payments.
  • Automatic invoices – raised when a payment is recorded, or, by setting, at confirmation, at completion or by hand.
  • Invoice link for customers – a “View Invoice” button in the confirmation email opens the invoice without a login.
  • Your numbering – your own invoice prefix and series (continuous, reset every financial year or every month), credit notes with their own CN- numbers, and clear statuses such as Unpaid, Partly paid, Paid, Overdue and Refunded.

Setup wizard, change history & translation

  • Guided setup wizard – walks you through your business details, services and staff, so you can go live in minutes.
  • Change history & audit log – every change to bookings and locations is recorded. History is kept for one year by default, and you can change the retention period or turn it off (Settings → System → Audit History).
  • Translation ready – all text uses the scheduliyo text domain, so you can run your booking system in your own language.

Who is Scheduliyo for?

  • Salons, barbershops and beauty studios – salon appointment booking with availability for each staff member.
  • Spas and wellness centres – massage and therapy session scheduling.
  • Clinics, dentists and therapists – patient appointment booking with reminders.
  • Consultants, coaches and agencies – consultation and discovery-call booking.
  • Tutors and training centres – lesson and tutoring session scheduling.
  • Fitness trainers and studios – personal training session booking.
  • Service and repair businesses – service appointment and visit scheduling.

Scheduliyo Pro

Scheduliyo Pro is a separate plugin for businesses that need more. It adds online payments, SMS notifications, staff invitations, custom roles and seats. The free plugin stays fully functional on its own and never needs a license key. Learn more at scheduliyo.com.

Support

Questions or ideas? Ask in the Scheduliyo support forum, or email info@scheduliyo.com.

External services

Scheduliyo works on your own server. It contacts the outside services below only in the situations described. No API key or account is needed for any of them, except an SMTP server of your own if you choose to send email through one.

OpenStreetMap Nominatim (address search)

  • What it is used for: finding a location’s address and coordinates when you set or edit your business location.
  • When: only when an administrator, on the location map, presses Search (or Enter) for an address, clicks the map, drags the pin, or uses Use my location. Nothing is searched while you type. The map is offered in two places: the Address tab of a location in Settings → Locations, and the Setup Wizard‘s Business Details step, after Find on map is pressed. The request is made by your server, not your browser.
  • What is sent: the address text you searched for, or the coordinates of the pin, plus a user agent that names the plugin (Scheduliyo and its version) and your site’s address, as Nominatim’s usage policy requires.
  • How often: answers are kept on your site for a day, so repeating a search sends nothing. Your site sends at most one request a second, shared by every administrator; a lookup made sooner is refused with “The address lookup is busy” and nothing is sent.
  • Enabled by: an administrator using the map as described; nothing is sent otherwise.
  • Turning it off: add add_filter( 'scheduliyo/geocoder/enabled', '__return_false' ); to your site (for example in a small must-use plugin). Your site then never contacts Nominatim, not even to reuse a saved answer. The map’s search box is hidden; you can still place the pin by hand and type the address. This setting is per site and lives in your site’s code: neither Scheduliyo nor OpenStreetMap can switch it remotely. It does not affect the map tiles below.
  • Usage Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/nominatim/
  • Privacy Policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy

OpenStreetMap map tiles

  • What it is used for: showing the location map, in Settings → Locations and on the Setup Wizard‘s Business Details step.
  • When: only while an administrator has that map on screen: on the Address tab of a location in Settings → Locations, or after Find on map is pressed in the Setup Wizard. Only the map area on screen is loaded; nothing is downloaded in advance. The map images are loaded by the administrator’s browser, directly from OpenStreetMap.
  • What is sent: the administrator’s IP address, browser user agent, your site’s address (as the referrer, which the tile policy asks browsers to send) and the map area being viewed.
  • Enabled by: opening the location map in either place; nothing is loaded otherwise.
  • Tile Usage Policy: https://operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/tiles/
  • Privacy Policy: https://osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy

Your SMTP server (optional)

If you enter SMTP settings, booking emails are delivered through the mail server you choose. Scheduliyo signs in to that server with the username and password you entered, and the server receives each email and its recipient, as it would for any mail. Its terms and privacy policy are those of your email provider.

Amazon S3 and S3-compatible storage (moving earlier images back)

Scheduliyo stores every image you upload in your own site’s uploads folder (wp-content/uploads/scheduleos/images) and does not upload images to S3. An early version could store images in an S3 bucket instead, so a site that used it may still hold image addresses that point there. The only thing Scheduliyo does with them is copy those images back.

  • What it is used for: downloading images whose stored address still points at S3 and saving them in your WordPress media library, so that your site no longer depends on the bucket.
  • When: only when an administrator presses Migrate S3 Images to Local Media on the Image Storage settings card (Settings → Advanced). The requests are made by your server.
  • What is sent: one ordinary download request for each such image, to the address stored for it: an Amazon S3 address (amazonaws.com) or the address of an S3-compatible storage host (one containing s3.). No access key, secret key or other credential is sent, and no booking or customer details. Like any request WordPress makes, it carries WordPress’s standard user agent, which includes your site’s address.
  • Enabled by: an administrator starting the migration; nothing is sent otherwise, and a site with no such image addresses contacts nothing.
  • Amazon S3 Terms of Service: https://aws.amazon.com/service-terms/
  • Amazon Privacy Policy: https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/
  • For another S3-compatible host, the terms and privacy policy are those of that storage provider.

Links a person chooses to open

Scheduliyo sends nothing to these services itself. They are ordinary links, and information reaches the service only if the person clicks the link.

  • Google Calendar and Outlook.com: the booking confirmation offers “Add to Calendar” links. Clicking one sends the booking’s service name, date, time and location to that calendar service.
  • Google Maps: a location can offer a directions link. Clicking it sends the branch’s address to Google Maps.
  • WhatsApp: a customer with a referral code can share it. Clicking the link sends the referral message to WhatsApp.
  • scheduliyo.com: links in the admin area, and the “Powered by” link if you turn it on, open the plugin’s website.
  • Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Microsoft Services Agreement: https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement
  • Microsoft Privacy Statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement
  • WhatsApp Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • WhatsApp Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

Source code

Every file in Scheduliyo is either readable as shipped or built from readable source that is included in this plugin. Nothing is obfuscated.

  • Admin app: assets/dist/admin/ is compiled with Vite from the Vue and TypeScript source in resources/admin/.
  • Booking widget stylesheet: resources/public/styles/booking-widget.min.css is built from the parts in resources/styles-src/booking-widget/, which are joined into resources/public/styles/booking-widget.css and then minified.
  • Booking widget and Manage Booking scripts: resources/public/booking-widget.js and resources/public/manage-booking.js ship as written and are not compiled.
  • PHP: everything under src/ ships as written.

To rebuild the compiled files, run these two commands in the plugin folder (Node.js 18 or later):

npm install
npm run build

The build files (package.json, package-lock.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js and the build/ folder) are included in the plugin.

Third-party libraries served as shipped, in minified form, with their public source:

  • Alpine.js 3.15.8 (assets/vendor/alpinejs/, MIT): https://github.com/alpinejs/alpine
  • Lucide 0.575.0 (assets/vendor/lucide/, ISC): https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide

Libraries bundled into the admin app by the build above, at the versions pinned in package-lock.json: Vue 3.5.29, Vue Router 4.6.4, Pinia 2.3.1, FullCalendar 6.1.20 (with Preact 10.12.1), FullCalendar Premium 6.1.20, Chart.js 4.5.1 (with @kurkle/color 0.3.4), vue-chartjs 5.3.3, Leaflet 1.9.4, Cropper.js 1.6.2, jsQR 1.4.0, lucide-vue-next 0.575.0, Simple Icons 16.23.0 and Tailwind CSS 3.4.19. PHP libraries in vendor/: Action Scheduler 4.2.0, chillerlan/php-qrcode 6.0.1 and chillerlan/php-settings-container 3.3.0. The LICENSE file lists each one with its licence and source.

License

Scheduliyo is free software, released under the GNU General Public License version 2 or (at your option) any later version. See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html.

It includes third-party libraries under GPL-compatible licences (MIT, ISC, BSD-2-Clause, Apache-2.0, CC0-1.0 and GPLv3), listed with their sources in the LICENSE file. Two of them are used under GPLv3: Action Scheduler, and FullCalendar Premium under its GPLv3 option. Scheduliyo’s “version 2 or any later version” includes version 3, so the plugin as distributed may be used and redistributed under GPLv3.

The web fonts the plugin uses are bundled with it and served from your own site: Inter, IBM Plex Mono, Newsreader, Space Grotesk, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Roboto, Open Sans, Poppins, Outfit, Lora, Playfair Display, Bricolage Grotesque and Space Mono. Each is licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; the licence and copyright notice for each family are in assets/fonts.
sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New.
  2. Search for Scheduliyo, click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open Scheduliyo in the admin menu and follow the setup wizard to add your business details, working hours, services and staff.
  4. Add the booking form to a page with the [scheduliyo_booking] shortcode or the Scheduliyo Booking block, then publish the page.
  5. Add the [scheduliyo_manage_booking] shortcode to a page so customers can reschedule or cancel their appointments.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP and upload the scheduliyo folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate Scheduliyo on the Plugins screen.
  3. Complete steps 3–5 above.

Scheduliyo requires PHP 8.2 or newer and WordPress 6.5 or newer.
sections.faq:
Is Scheduliyo a free appointment booking plugin?

Yes. The free version is fully functional, with no limit on services, staff members, locations, customers or bookings. Scheduliyo Pro is a separate plugin with further features; the free plugin does not need it.

Do I need an account or a license key?

No. Install and activate the plugin and you can take bookings straight away. The free plugin does not connect to any Scheduliyo account or license server.

How do I add a booking form to my WordPress site?

Add the [scheduliyo_booking] shortcode or the Scheduliyo Booking block to any page or post, then publish it.

Can customers reschedule or cancel their own appointments?

Yes. Each confirmation email has a secure link to the manage-booking page, where customers reschedule or cancel without an account. Add that page with the [scheduliyo_manage_booking] shortcode.

Does Scheduliyo send appointment reminders?

Yes. Automatic email reminders go out a chosen number of hours before each confirmed appointment, and you can send a reminder by hand from any booking.

How are booking confirmation and reminder emails sent?

Through WordPress’s own mail function by default. For better deliverability, you can enter your own SMTP server in the settings.

Do staff members need WordPress logins?

No. Scheduliyo is run by your site’s administrators. A staff member is a booking record – working hours, services and location – and can be booked without a WordPress account. The free plugin does not create logins for staff. A WordPress user you give one of Scheduliyo’s roles (Users → Edit) can use the screens that role allows. Inviting staff, custom roles and per-role seats are part of Scheduliyo Pro.

Can customers pay online when they book?

Online payments are part of Scheduliyo Pro. The free plugin lets you record offline payments, such as cash taken at the appointment, including deposits and part payments.

Does Scheduliyo create invoices?

Yes. An invoice is raised when a payment is recorded (or, by setting, at confirmation, at completion or by hand), numbered with your own prefix and series. Customers open it from the “View Invoice” button in their confirmation email.

Can I manage multiple staff members, services and locations?

Yes, as many as you need. Each service has its own duration and price, and each staff member has their own working hours, breaks and time off.

Will Scheduliyo work with my theme?

The booking form is added with a shortcode or a block, so you can place it on any page or post of your theme.

Is Scheduliyo translation ready?

Yes. All text uses the scheduliyo text domain, so the plugin can be translated into your language.

Where is my booking data stored?

In your own WordPress database. The free plugin does not send bookings or customer details to Scheduliyo or any other service.

How do I get support?

Ask in the Scheduliyo support forum on WordPress.org, or email info@scheduliyo.com.

Does Scheduliyo contact other websites?

Only in the situations listed under External services below. If you set up your own SMTP server, it delivers your booking emails. The other services receive no booking or customer details.
sections.changelog:
1.7.8

  • Fixed: the “Require Address” booking setting now adds a required address field to the booking form, and bookings without an address are refused while it is on.
  • Fixed: an address given for an in-person booking no longer makes emails, the booking page or the calendar treat the appointment as a home visit.
  • Fixed: on some booking form designs, home-visit services did not show the address field, so the booking could not continue.
  • Improved: a required phone number is no longer shown as an error before the customer has had a chance to enter it.

1.7.7

  • Invoices are now raised at the right moment: for an online booking when its payment succeeds, and for a pay-at-venue booking when its payment is recorded (or, by setting, at confirmation, at completion, or manually). Until then the confirmation email shows the amount due instead of an invoice link.
  • Deposits and part payments: an invoice shows Partly paid, with the amount paid and the balance due.
  • Invoices follow their booking: an unpaid invoice is voided when the booking is cancelled, or when a booking that was never confirmed expires; a paid invoice is never voided — a credit note records what was refunded or not kept. A price change restates an unpaid invoice, or adds a supplementary invoice or a credit note beside a paid one.
  • Clear invoice statuses (Draft, Unpaid, Partly paid, Paid, Overdue, Void, Refunded, Partly refunded); whether an invoice was emailed is shown separately.
  • Credit notes have their own CN- numbering, and invoice and credit-note numbers stay unique when several are raised at once.
  • The invoice prefix and numbering settings now take effect: new invoices use your prefix and the series you choose — Continuous, reset every financial year (April–March), or reset every month — counted in your business’s time zone.
  • Staff whose role allows creating notifications can now create the ready-made reminder template from Settings → Booking; previously only site administrators could.

1.7.5

  • First release on WordPress.org.

  • Enabled by: an administrator starting the migration; nothing is sent otherwise, and a site with no such image addresses contacts nothing.
  • Amazon S3 Terms of Service: https://aws.amazon.com/service-terms/
  • Amazon Privacy Policy: https://aws.amazon.com/privacy/
  • For another S3-compatible host, the terms and privacy policy are those of that storage provider.

Links a person chooses to open

Scheduliyo sends nothing to these services itself. They are ordinary links, and information reaches the service only if the person clicks the link.

  • Google Calendar and Outlook.com: the booking confirmation offers “Add to Calendar” links. Clicking one sends the booking’s service name, date, time and location to that calendar service.
  • Google Maps: a location can offer a directions link. Clicking it sends the branch’s address to Google Maps.
  • WhatsApp: a customer with a referral code can share it. Clicking the link sends the referral message to WhatsApp.
  • scheduliyo.com: links in the admin area, and the “Powered by” link if you turn it on, open the plugin’s website.
  • Google Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
  • Google Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
  • Microsoft Services Agreement: https://www.microsoft.com/servicesagreement
  • Microsoft Privacy Statement: https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement
  • WhatsApp Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
  • WhatsApp Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy

Source code

Every file in Scheduliyo is either readable as shipped or built from readable source that is included in this plugin. Nothing is obfuscated.

  • Admin app: assets/dist/admin/ is compiled with Vite from the Vue and TypeScript source in resources/admin/.
  • Booking widget stylesheet: resources/public/styles/booking-widget.min.css is built from the parts in resources/styles-src/booking-widget/, which are joined into resources/public/styles/booking-widget.css and then minified.
  • Booking widget and Manage Booking scripts: resources/public/booking-widget.js and resources/public/manage-booking.js ship as written and are not compiled.
  • PHP: everything under src/ ships as written.

To rebuild the compiled files, run these two commands in the plugin folder (Node.js 18 or later):

npm install
npm run build

The build files (package.json, package-lock.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.js, postcss.config.js and the build/ folder) are included in the plugin.

Third-party libraries served as shipped, in minified form, with their public source:

  • Lucide 0.575.0 (assets/vendor/lucide/, ISC): https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide
